visual_description: A man wearing a green USGS cap and t-shirt smiles while holding a tall surveying pole with a GNSS receiver on top. The pole has “SPECTRA” printed vertically in white letters. A yellow box is mounted mid-pole, and the man’s hands grip lower sections near adjustment knobs. In the background is an open field of dry grass under a partly cloudy sky. At bottom right, small text reads: “ISSN 2330-5703 (online) https://doi.org/10.3133/cir1564”. No charts, tables, or diagrams are present. Crop is clear.
